newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Jinro, Chung Won limit-down.
newsitem.headline: Jinro, Chung Won limit-down.

text.p: Shares of Jinro Ltd and Chung Won Corp resumed trading after a one-day halt and went limit-down at the market opening on Wednesday on concerns about their financial situation, brokers said.
Liquor producer Jinro fell 720 won to 8,350 and Chung Won lost 500 won to 5,830.
On Tuesday the Korea Stock Exchange suspended trading in Jinro shares after Jinro failed to honour 50.4 billion won worth of promissory notes and cheques called in on Monday.
Trading of Chung Won shares was also halted on Tuesday after talk, later confirmed by the company, that it had failed to settle repayments on debts.
Textile maker Chung Won announced late on Tuesday it had settled repayments on 800 million worth of promissory notes before the final deadline of the close of business on Tuesday.
